title: Lighthouse Beacon Rotation Assembly Maintenance
originalRequest: Perform scheduled inspection of the Fresnel lens rotation mechanism and lubricate the bearing track.
latestMessage: Perform scheduled inspection of the Fresnel lens rotation mechanism and lubricate the bearing track.

steps.title: Inspect and lubricate lower bearing track (Attempt 2 - BLOCKED)
steps.instruction: Clean old grease from the lower bearing track, inspect rollers for flat spots, and apply high-viscosity marine lubricant. Note: Previous attempt failed due to seized access hatch bolts.
steps.acceptance: Rollers must rotate freely with zero lateral play, and the track must be free of particulate contamination. Access hatch must be successfully opened.
